description: Quote the exact Gold price to make an owned portrait speak supplied text. Returns gold_cost and quote_token without starting a job or charging Gold. After the user approves, call chargen_generate_portrait_tts with the same inputs and quote_token.

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio supported by the model, such as 16:9.

duration_seconds.description: Video duration in seconds, where supported by the model.

model.description: Enabled video model supporting portrait-tts; chargen_list_media_models can help choose a model. This never changes the operation.

prompt.description: Optional: how the portrait looks or moves while it speaks. The words go in speech_text.

resolution.description: Resolution supported by the model, such as 720p.

source_image_id.description: Owned still image to animate or use as the portrait.

voice.description: Voice supported by the selected model.

name: chargen_quote_portrait_tts
title: Quote portrait tts
